problem: Legal authorization or ceiling does not prove issuance delivery or payment.
rule: Keep authorization in its own phase and never carry amounts forward automatically.
evidence: Decree 214 art. 7; Decree 905 arts. 28-29; Law 25.796 arts. 2-4

problem: Decree 905 defines entity-level balance formulas without a closed aggregate amount.
rule: Report the formula and leave the aggregate open until issuer/accounting evidence supplies it.

problem: Issued and placed debt is a liability stock rather than a cash disbursement.
rule: Label stock and instrument; do not call it paid cash.

problem: Original nominal amount and updated ARS/USD values are different measures.
rule: Preserve source currency date and valuation basis; never mix columns.

problem: End-year stocks combine issuance amortization redemption valuation and corrections.
rule: Do not infer annual flows from stock deltas without a transaction bridge.

problem: Treasury issuer stock and BCRA-reported bank holdings/receivables cover different universes.
rule: Keep ONP/CGN issuer tables separate from BCRA beneficiary balance-sheet stocks.
evidence: ONP 2003Q4 cuadro 37; BCRA BEF table IV.1

problem: Compensaciones a recibir are recognized claims rather than delivered assets.
rule: Classify as receivable and not as payment.

problem: CGN transfers-granted rows are compatibility/reconciliation entries between budget and accounting records.
rule: Use as accounting recognition and not as proof of cash movement.

problem: Broad BODEN totals include compensation coverage depositors quasi-currency redemption and 13-percent restitution.
rule: Use the official purpose buckets and never label total BODEN as bank aid.

problem: Coverage can involve exchange or subscription and potential BCRA financing after applying peso bonds.
rule: Separate compensation exchange subscription and BCRA advance legs.

problem: BCRA advances and BCRA obligations to the Treasury are financing balances.
rule: Keep them out of Treasury compensation flows.

problem: Sixty-installment loss deferral smooths accounting recognition.
rule: Exclude from fiscal transfer amounts.

problem: The definitive compensation amount and assets remained pending at end-2003.
rule: Do not publish a final through-2003 realized total.

problem: Named 2003 accounting entries may overlap pre-existing instrument stocks.
rule: Do not add Galicia/Citibank notes to ONP stocks without instrument identifiers and dates.

problem: A compensation asset can coexist with losses funding costs duration mismatch and FX mismatch.
rule: Do not equate gross compensation with bank profit or final household-to-bank incidence.
evidence: BCRA Congress 2002 pp.28-36; BCRA BEF pp.8-49

problem: hist_bcra_baldethis.xls contains risk/result tables but no detailed fiscal compensation ledger.
rule: Record the negative audit and do not fabricate a fiscal series from unrelated balance rows.

problem: A later budget law can validate an earlier extra-budgetary registration.
rule: Attribute the amount to its original accounting period and keep the later act non-additive.

problem: Qualitative administrative finalization can precede later issues and corrections.
rule: Do not treat narrative closure language as a transactional endpoint.
evidence: CGN 2004 SDP p.71; CGN 2005-2006 SDP Anexo J

problem: Net issuance after prior-placement adjustments can be negative.
rule: Preserve the sign and do not replace with zero or call it amortization.
evidence: CGN 2005 SDP p.87; CGN 2006 SDP p.132

problem: A devengado transfer is not proof of cash settlement by beneficiary and date.
rule: Label budget accrual and require payment records for cash.
evidence: CGN 2005 tomo I p.118; CGN 2006 tomo I p.142

problem: Budget headings combine banks and depositors.
rule: Use bank-specific rows when available; keep the mixed bucket as control only.

problem: The 2006 assistance bucket includes BNA capitalization.
rule: Subtract nothing mechanically; retain the whole bucket as non-additive and use identified components separately.

problem: BODEN 2007 and 2012 service aggregates holders from multiple purposes.
rule: Do not allocate series amortization to banks without holder-purpose records.

problem: Coverage bonds are subscribed and can involve a price payment and financing.
rule: Separate VNO issue subscription paid and price-difference transfer.

problem: Financial-entity deposits under Decree 905 run from banks to the Treasury.
rule: Keep the counterflow out of gross Treasury-to-bank compensation.
evidence: CGN 2005 tomo I p.124; CGN 2006 tomo I p.136

problem: A financing-source placement line differs from a current-transfer accrual.
rule: Never sum placement financing with transfer execution absent accounting keys.

problem: Law 25.796 ceiling and later net issues are different phases.
rule: Report authorized ceiling separately from 2005-2006 issuance.

problem: Official AGN search did not identify a mechanism-specific public report.
rule: Keep independent audit reconciliation open and do not substitute unrelated reports.
